subject: Request: EU hosting attestation, SCCs & evidence packet
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@mediushealth.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: EU hosting attestation, SCCs & evidence packet

Hi Naomi,

We're progressing through Medius Health's procurement flow and need a firm attestation and supporting evidence that processing for our account and any backups will be contained within the EU. The key items our legal/compliance team requires are: 

- A signed attestation on letterhead confirming EU-only processing and that data will not egress to non-EU regions for the account associated with deal RDW-4839-MH.
- Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) we can review and countersign (or a statement you rely on the EU annex).
- SIG/CAIQ or similar questionnaire answers; if you have a vendor security pack (SIG/CAIQ + SOC 2), please include.
- A copy of your latest SOC 2 report (redacted is fine).
- Confirmation on backup/replication practices and retention; does Redwood maintain backups outside the region?
- Details on VPC/private connectivity (Private Connect / On-prem connector) and KMS/HSM options for keys.
- Any DPIA input or data-flow diagrams you can provide to help our privacy team complete their assessment.

We have an internal deadline of 2026-11-12 to complete review and get countersignatures. Can you provide an evidence packet (PDF bundle) and an estimated delivery date? If possible, we prefer DocuSign-ready attestation language so legal can sign quickly.

I've attached our procurement checklist to show the items they will cross off. If there are any constraints (e.g., certain features only available on Dedicated/Private), please call that out.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Morales
Sr. Procurement Manager, Medius Health
elena.morales@mediushealth.com
[Attachment: medius-procurement-checklist.xlsx]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@mediushealth.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: EU hosting attestation, SCCs & evidence packet

Elena —

Thanks for the clear list and timeline. Happy to help; I've looped in Engineering (Aditya), Security (Vivek) and Solutions (Laura) so we can assemble a complete packet. High-level answer up front: we can provide EU-region-only processing for your account via our EU-hosted region with Private Connect; we also have options for Dedicated/Private deployments if you need contractual guarantees beyond configuration controls.

Immediate next steps I propose:
- We'll produce an evidence bundle with SCCs, a redacted SOC 2, a SCCs assertion PDF and a short data flow diagram.
- Vivek will confirm backup/replication topology and whether any system-level telemetry leaves the EU.
- Aditya will outline the VPC onboarding steps (Private Connect, routing, KMS options) and an estimated lead time.
- We'll draft an attestation letter you can countersign (DocuSign-ready).

Prelim attachments I'm sending now: Redwood SOC 2 (redacted) and our VPC onboarding guide — these should help your legal and infra teams start. We'll follow up with SCCs and the formal attestation within 3 business days.

Quick question: does Medius require the attestation to reference specific data categories (PHI/PII) or is a per-account jurisdictional attestation sufficient? Also, do you consider backups "processing" for your risk model (sometimes clients treat backup copies differently).

I'll aim to have the SCCs assertion and attestation draft by Wed, 2026-11-04 EOD. If you need something sooner we can escalate.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
[Attachments: redwood-soc2-report-2026.pdf, vpc-onboarding-guide.pdf]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: EU hosting attestation, SCCs & evidence packet

Naomi / team —

A few technical clarifications and what we can provide as evidence: 

- Backup/replication: For hosted EU accounts we replicate inside EU AZs only. We do not replicate host backups to non-EU regions for accounts configured with the EU-only routing policy. We will include an ops diagram showing storage and replication boundaries.
- SCCs & Attestation: We maintain an SCCs assertion PDF for EU-only processing customers; Legal can sign the SCC Annex. We'll attach our SCCs text and a short signed assertion document.
- KMS/HSM: We support customer-managed keys via KMS in EU regions; for Dedicated/Private we can offer HSM-backed key management — we'll include configuration notes and limitations.
- DPIA support: We can provide a data flow diagram and answers to your DPIA template questions. We won't run the DPIA for you, but our privacy engineering will provide the inputs.
- Evidence we can include: redwood-sccs-assertion-2026.pdf, data-flow-eu-account.png (inline), SOC 2 (redacted), CAIQ answers (summary).

Operational runbook (high level):
1) Confirm account region & routing policy (2 business days).
2) Enable EU-only routing and validate via test tokens (3 business days).
3) If Private Connect requested, schedule onboarding window (2-6 weeks depending on customer network).
4) Deliver attestation + evidence bundle (3 business days from steps 1–2).

I filed SEC-1298 to track the evidence packet and will post the artifacts to the Drive link Naomi referenced. If procurement needs a signed letter on firm letterhead, Legal can prepare that once we have the exact account name and the requested wording (please see my suggested attestation template in the Drive).

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood-sccs-assertion-2026.pdf]

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@mediushealth.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@mediushealth.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 15:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: EU hosting attestation, SCCs & evidence packet

Thanks Naomi and Vivek — this is helpful and aligns with what our privacy team needs. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- Please include explicit language that "backups and replication associated with the account will remain within the European Economic Area (EEA)" in the attestation.
- We prefer the attestation to reference the Medius account name (Medius Health - Production) and the deal id (RDW-4839-MH).
- DocuSign would be ideal. If you can share a DocuSign-ready PDF of the attestation we can route for signatures next week.

Would appreciate the SCCs assertion and the attestation draft by Wednesday 2026-11-04 so we can hit our internal review window. Let me know if any item requires procurement signoff vs legal.

Elena
Elena Morales
Sr. Procurement Manager, Medius Health
[Attachment: medius-supplier-onboarding-form.pdf]
